mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.6% (as of the latest data) indicates an accommodative monetary policy, which is associated with positive 20-day forward returns on the S&P 500 due to low interest rates supporting equity valuations and economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS < 0.6% (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.5% indicates a restrictive monetary policy, which is associated with negative 20-day forward returns on the S&P 500 due to higher interest rates compressing equity valuations and reducing economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When manufacturing output (INDPRO) is above its 2017 base (100) and employment (PAYEMS) is above 145,000,000, the S&P 500 exhibits positive 60-day forward returns due to strong economic activity supporting corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when INDPRO > 100 and PAYEMS > 145000 (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of strong GDP growth (year-over-year growth above 2%), the S&P 500 exhibits positive 5-day forward returns due to robust economic conditions supporting corporate earnings and investor confidence.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive when year-over-year GDP growth is above 2% (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (below 5%) is associated with negative 60-day forward returns on the S&P 500 because it indicates a tight labor market that may lead to inflationary pressures and subsequent monetary tightening.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE < 5% (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1100 thousand units, the S&P 500 exhibits positive 5-day forward returns due to strong consumer confidence and economic activity.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive when HOUST > 1100 (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is below 0.6% and the CPI (year-over-year) is above 242.0 (indicating inflationary pressure), the S&P 500 exhibits negative 20-day forward returns due to the risk of premature monetary tightening.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS < 0.6 and CPIAUCSL > 242.0 (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of manufacturing contraction (INDPRO below 100), the S&P 500 exhibits negative 60-day forward returns due to declining industrial activity and reduced corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO < 100 (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.
